source_inventory_scope: All .py/.js/.css/.sh/.ps1/.cmd/.bat/.toml/.yaml/.yml files outside environments, caches, git metadata, downloaded checkpoints and third_party. JSON configuration and bounded reports also selected. Files larger than3MB not inventoried as source; no first-party code exceeded that cap.
upstream_status: External immutable Git revisions; upstream code is not vendored
normalization: __LOCAL_WORKSPACE__, __LOCAL_HOME__, __LOCAL_CHAT__ replace machine-specific paths and coordination identities. No scientific numerical expressions intentionally edited.
